title: Final review of Phase 1 epic diff
description: Review the integrated Phase 1 diff: lease correctness under concurrency and after crash, stop and budget enforcement living in the control plane rather than in a prompt, credential scope of the orchestrator sandbox, gateway telemetry as the cost authority, artifact streaming during the run, and the absence of any mid-run mutation path (D21). Verify against a REAL deployment, not only the test harness - Phase 0 shipped two production breaks that a fully green suite could not see.
